scope: Group draft controls around the message editor
limitations: Headless WebKit with isolated observations. Native OS input, assistive technology and Rust command integration were not exercised.

conversation--expanded-editor-compact-da.task: Write and send with draft status and secondary controls using less vertical space.
conversation--expanded-editor-compact-da.observations: Editor label, character count, saved status and Done writing now share one compact toolbar. The text area gains the removed row; Add files, agent choice and Send remain aligned below. At 760 × 550 all toolbar items fit with clear separation. Focus, text contrast and control edges remain clear in this appearance.
